A1.justification: Both PDFs describe T2ICount and provide readable text, equations, figures and tables for comparison. Both contain ten pages ending with references; neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original counting experiments on FSC-147, FSC-147-S and CARPK, component ablations in Table 4, and qualitative predictions.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark experiments, component ablations and qualitative predictions in Tables 1–4 and Figures 1–5.

M1.justification: Equation 6 replaces the background cutoff of half the mean fused attention with θ. Because v3 specifies neither θ's value nor its relationship to the earlier cutoff, it is unclear whether negative-region selection actually changes or is merely reparameterized. The architecture and remaining loss structure are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use FSC-147, the same 196-image FSC-147-S subset, and CARPK. Replacing 'simple synthetic dataset' with FSC-147 reannotation in related work corrects the description to match the dataset construction already documented in v1 Section 4.1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3. For example, both FSC-147-S comparisons include CLIP-Count, CounTX, VLCounter, PseCo and DAVE. Removing the reference-less related-work subsection does not remove its methods from the reported comparisons.

E3.justification: The stated evaluation design remains unchanged: FSC-147 splits of 3,659/1,286/1,190 images, MAE/RMSE metrics, 400 training epochs, batch size 16, and 384×384 inference windows with stride 384. No new experimental protocol is reported.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the baseline, baseline plus LRRC, and full HSCM configurations on FSC-147 and FSC-147-S. The attention-map analyses and qualitative counting examples are also retained; figure relocation introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or comparable uncertainty estimates. The reporting practice remains point estimates and qualitative visualizations.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–4 and the qualitative predictions are retained. T2ICount still reports MAE/RMSE of 11.76/97.86 on FSC-147 test, 4.69/8.06 on FSC-147-S, and 8.61/13.47 on CARPK. No numerical results or reported rankings change.

T1.justification: The written PNA definition in Equation 6 replaces the explicit mean-dependent background bound with an unspecified threshold θ and removes the accompanying definition of the attention-map average. This is a limited formal specification revision; the other equations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same central claims about diffusion-based counting, HSCM, LRRC, majority-category evaluation bias, FSC-147-S and competitive or superior counting performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of text insensitivity, benchmark bias, the roles of LRRC and HSCM, and cross-dataset generalization remain unchanged. The future-work proposal for a more diverse dataset is retained, with no new substantive limitations or applicability qualifications.

D1.justification: v1 supplies a half-mean rule for the background cutoff; v3 leaves θ without a value or selection procedure, reducing reproducibility of LRRC. Other implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and code-access information remain unchanged. Figure 2 largely repeats training information already in Section 4.2.

R1.justification: v3 removes the dedicated discussion of reference-less counting, including RepRPN-Counter and RCC, while retaining those citations elsewhere. Section 3.1 adds Chen et al.'s image-manipulation dataset and Zhang et al.'s diffusion-based manipulation-localization references. The broader research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Limited edits correct 'denosing' and the synthetic-dataset description, remove one related-work subsection, renumber the zero-shot subsection, and add author-role footnotes and funding acknowledgements. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 2 adds frozen/trainable symbols and an explanatory caption sentence. Figure 4 moves from page 8 to page 7, Table 4 is repositioned within page 8, and surrounding text reflows. Page-number footers disappear; the remaining scientific displays retain their content and structure.

improvement.justification: v3 corrects the dataset wording and clarifies Figure 2, but replaces v1's calculable background cutoff with an unspecified θ in Equation 6. This leaves an additional gap in reproducing LRRC, a central contribution. That reproducibility loss outweighs the limited presentation gains; the empirical evidence remains unchanged.
